ayahs.1: Alif Laam Ra, yeh kitaab-e-Ilahi ki aayaten hain aur khule aur raushan Quran ki.
ayahs.2: Woh bhi waqt hoga ke kaafir apne musalmaan hone ki aarzoo karenge.
ayahs.3: Aap unhen khaata, nafa uthaata aur (jhooti) umeedon mein mashghool hota chhod dijiye, anqareeb yeh khud jaan lenge.
ayahs.4: Kisi basti ko hum ne halaak nahin kiya magar yeh ke is ke liye muqarrara nawishta tha.
ayahs.5: Koi giroh apni maut se na aage badhta hai na peechhe rehta hai.
ayahs.6: Unhon ne kaha ke aye woh shakhs jis par Quran utaara gaya hai yaqeenan tu to koi deewaana hai.
ayahs.7: Agar tu sachcha hi hai to hamare paas farishton ko kyun nahin laata.
ayahs.8: Hum farishton ko haq ke saath hi utaarte hain aur us waqt woh mohlat diye gaye nahin hote.
ayahs.9: Hum ne hi is Quran ko naazil farmaya hai aur hum hi is ke muhaafiz hain.
ayahs.10: Hum ne aap se pehle agli ummaton mein bhi apne Rasool (baraabar) bheje.
ayahs.11: Aur (lekin) jo bhi Rasool aata woh is ka mazaaq udaate.
ayahs.12: Gunahgaaron ke dilon mein hum isi tarah yehi racha diya karte hain.
ayahs.13: Woh is par imaan nahin laate aur yaqeenan aglon ka tareeqa guzra hua hai.
ayahs.14: Aur agar hum in par aasman ka darwaza khol bhi den aur yeh wahan chadhne bhi lag jaayen.
ayahs.15: Tab bhi yehi kahenge ke hamari nazar-bandi kar di gayi hai balke hum logon par jaadu kar diya gaya hai.
ayahs.16: Yaqeenan hum ne aasman mein burj banaaye hain aur dekhne walon ke liye use saja diya hai.
ayahs.17: Aur use har mardood shaitan se mahfooz rakha hai.
ayahs.18: Haan magar jo chori chhupe sunne ki koshish kare is ke peechhe dahakta hua (khula shola) lagta hai.
ayahs.19: Aur zameen ko hum ne phaila diya hai aur is par (atal) pahaad daal diye hain, aur is mein hum ne har cheez ek muayyan miqdaar se uga di hai.
ayahs.20: Aur isi mein hum ne tumhari roziyan bana di hain aur jinhen tum rozi dene wale nahin ho.
ayahs.21: Aur jitni bhi cheezen hain un sab ke khazane hamare paas hain, aur hum har cheez ko is ke muqarrara andaaz se utaarte hain.
ayahs.22: Aur hum bhejte hain bojhal hawaayen, phir aasman se paani barsa kar woh tumhein pilaate hain aur tum is ka zakheera karne wale nahin ho.
ayahs.23: Hum hi jilaate aur maarte hain aur hum hi (bil-aakhir) waaris hain.
ayahs.24: Aur tum mein se aage badhne wale aur peechhe hatne wale bhi hamare ilm mein hain.
ayahs.25: Aap ka Rabb sab logon ko jama karega, yaqeenan woh badi hikmaton wala bade ilm wala hai.
ayahs.26: Yaqeenan hum ne insan ko kaali aur sadi hui khankhanaati mitti se, paida farmaya hai.
ayahs.27: Aur is se pehle jinnaat ko hum ne loo wali aag se paida kiya.
ayahs.28: Aur jab tere parwardigar ne farishton se farmaya ke main ek insan ko kaali aur sadi hui khankhanaati mitti se paida karne wala hoon.
ayahs.29: To jab main use poora bana chukoon aur is mein apni rooh phoonk doon to tum sab is ke liye sajde mein gir padna.
ayahs.30: Chunaanche tamaam farishton ne sab ke sab ne sajda kar liya.
ayahs.31: Magar Iblees ke. Ke is ne sajda karne walon mein shumooliyat karne se (saaf) inkaar kar diya.
ayahs.32: (Allah Taala ne) farmaya aye Iblees tujhe kya hua ke tu sajda karne walon mein shaamil na hua?
ayahs.33: Woh bola ke main aisa nahin ke is insan ko sajda karoon jise tu ne kaali aur sadi hui khankhanaati mitti se paida kiya hai.
ayahs.34: Farmaya ab tu bahisht se nikal ja kyunke tu raanda-e-dargaah hai.
ayahs.35: Aur tujh par meri phitkaar hai qayamat ke din tak.
ayahs.36: Kehne laga ke aye mere Rabb! Mujhe us din tak ki dheel de ke log dobara utha khade kiye jaayen.
ayahs.37: Farmaya ke achcha tu un mein se hai jinhen mohlat mili hai.
ayahs.39: (Shaitan ne) kaha ke aye mere Rabb! Chunke tu ne mujhe gumraah kiya hai mujhe bhi qasam hai ke main bhi zameen mein un ke liye ma'aasi ko muzayyan karoonga aur un sab ko bahkaaunga bhi.
ayahs.40: Siwaye tere un bandon ke jo muntakhab kar liye gaye hain.
ayahs.41: Irshaad hua ke haan yehi mujh tak pahunchne ki seedhi raah hai.
ayahs.42: Mere bandon par tujhe koi ghalba nahin, lekin haan jo gumraah log teri pairwi karen.
ayahs.43: Yaqeenan un sab ke wade ki jagah jahannam hai.
ayahs.44: Jis ke saat darwaze hain. Har darwaze ke liye un ka ek hissa bata hua hai.
ayahs.45: Parhezgaar jannati log baaghon aur chashmon mein honge.
ayahs.46: (Un se kaha jaayega) salaamati aur amn ke saath is mein daakhil ho jao.
ayahs.47: Un ke dilon mein jo kuchh ranjish-o-keena tha, hum sab kuchh nikaal denge, woh bhai bhai bane hue ek doosre ke aamne saamne takhton par baithe honge.
ayahs.48: Na to wahan unhen koi takleef chhoo sakti hai aur na woh wahan se kabhi nikaale jaayenge.
ayahs.49: Mere bandon ko khabar de do ke main bahut hi bakhshne wala aur bada hi mehrbaan hoon.
ayahs.50: Aur saath hi mere azaab bhi nihaayat dardnaak hain.
ayahs.51: Unhen Ibraheem ke mehmaanon ka (bhi) haal suna do.
ayahs.52: Ke jab unhon ne un ke paas aa kar salaam kaha to unhon ne kaha ke hum ko to tum se dar lagta hai.
ayahs.53: Unhon ne kaha daro nahin, hum tujhe ek saahib-e-ilm farzand ki bushaarat dete hain.
ayahs.54: Kaha, kya is budhaape ke aa jaane ke baad tum mujhe khushkhabri dete ho! Yeh khushkhabri tum kaise de rahe ho?
ayahs.55: Unhon ne kaha hum aap ko bilkul sachchi khushkhabri sunaate hain, aap maayoos logon mein shaamil na hon.
ayahs.56: Kaha apne Rabb Taala ki rahmat se na-umeed to sirf gumraah aur bahke hue log hi hote hain.
ayahs.57: Poochha ke Allah ke bheje hue (farishto!) tumhara aisa kya aham kaam hai?
ayahs.58: Unhon ne jawab diya ke hum mujrim qaum ki taraf bheje gaye hain.
ayahs.59: Magar khaandaan-e-Loot ke hum un sab ko to zaroor bacha lenge.
ayahs.60: Siwaye is (Loot) ki biwi ke ke hum ne use rukne aur baaqi reh jaane walon mein muqarrar kar diya hai.
ayahs.61: Jab bheje hue farishte aal-e-Loot ke paas pahunche.
ayahs.62: To unhon (Loot alaihis salaam) ne kaha tum log to kuchh anjaan se maloom ho rahe ho.
ayahs.63: Unhon ne kaha nahin balke hum tere paas woh cheez laaye hain jis mein yeh log shak-shubha kar rahe the.
ayahs.64: Hum to tere paas (sareeh) haq laaye hain aur hain bhi bilkul sachche.
ayahs.65: Ab tu apne khaandaan samet is raat ke kisi hissa mein chal de aur aap un ke peechhe rehna, aur (khabardaar) tum mein se koi (peechhe) mud kar bhi na dekhe aur jahan ka tumhein hukm kiya ja raha hai wahan chale jaana.
ayahs.66: Aur hum ne is ki taraf is baat ka faisla kar diya ke subah hote hote in logon ki jaden kaat di jaayengi.
ayahs.67: Aur shehar wale khushiyan manaate hue aaye.
ayahs.68: (Loot alaihis salaam ne) kaha yeh log mere mehmaan hain, tum mujhe ruswa na karo.
ayahs.69: Allah Taala se daro aur mujhe ruswa na karo.
ayahs.70: Woh bole kya hum ne tujhe dunya bhar (ki thekedaari) se mana nahin kar rakha?
ayahs.71: (Loot alaihis salaam ne) kaha agar tumhein karna hi hai to yeh meri bachiyan maujood hain.
ayahs.72: Teri umr ki qasam! Woh to apni badmasti mein sargardaan the.
ayahs.73: Pas sooraj nikalte nikalte unhen ek bade zor ki aawaaz ne pakad liya.
ayahs.74: Bil-aakhir hum ne is shehar ko oopar tale kar diya aur in logon par kankar wale patthar barsaaye.
ayahs.75: Bila-shubha baseerat walon ke liye is mein bahut si nishaaniyan hain.
ayahs.76: Yeh basti aisi raah par hai jo baraabar chalti rehti (aam guzargah) hai.
ayahs.77: Aur is mein imaan walon ke liye badi nishani hai.
ayahs.78: Aur be-shak Aika basti ke rehne wale yaqeenan zaalim the.
ayahs.79: Jin se (aakhir) hum ne intiqaam le hi liya. Yeh donon shehar khule (aam) raaste par hain.
ayahs.80: Aur Hijr walon ne bhi Rasoolon ko jhutlaaya.
ayahs.81: Aur hum ne un ko apni nishaaniyan bhi ata farmaayin (lekin) taaham woh un se rogardaani hi karte rahe.
ayahs.82: Yeh log pahaadon ko taraash taraash kar ghar banaate the, be-khauf ho kar.
ayahs.83: Aakhir unhen bhi subah hote hote chinghaadne aa dabocha.
ayahs.84: Pas un ki kisi tadbeer-o-amal ne unhen koi faaida na diya.
ayahs.85: Hum ne aasmanon aur zameen ko aur un ke darmiyan ki sab cheezon ko haq ke saath hi paida farmaya hai, aur qayamat zaroor zaroor aane wali hai. Pas tu husn-o-khoobi (aur achchai) se darguzar kar le.
ayahs.86: Yaqeenan tera parwardigar hi paida karne wala aur jaanne wala hai.
ayahs.87: Yaqeenan hum ne aap ko saat aayaten de rakhi hain, jo dohraayi jaati hain, aur azeem Quran bhi de rakha hai.
ayahs.88: Aap hargiz apni nazren is cheez ki taraf na daudaayen, jis se hum ne in mein se kayi qisam ke logon ko behra-mand kar rakha hai, na un par aap afsos karen aur mominon ke liye apne baazu jhukaaye rahen.
ayahs.89: Aur keh dijiye ke main to khullam-khulla daraane wala hoon.
ayahs.90: Jaise ke hum ne un taqseem karne walon par utaara.
ayahs.91: Jinhon ne is kitaab-e-Ilahi ke tukde tukde kar diye.
ayahs.92: Qasam hai tere paalne wale ki! Hum in sab se zaroor baaz-purs karenge.
ayahs.93: Har us cheez ki jo woh karte the.
ayahs.94: Pas aap is hukm ko jo aap ko kiya ja raha hai khol kar suna dijiye! Aur mushrikon se munh pher lijiye.
ayahs.95: Aap se jo log maskhara-pan karte hain un ki saza ke liye hum kaafi hain.
ayahs.96: Jo Allah ke saath doosre mabood muqarrar karte hain unhen anqareeb maloom ho jaayega.
ayahs.97: Hamein khoob ilm hai ke un ki baaton se aap ka dil tang hota hai.
ayahs.98: Aap apne parwardigar ki tasbeeh aur hamd bayan karte rahen aur sajda karne walon mein shaamil ho jaayen.
ayahs.99: Aur apne Rabb ki ibaadat karte rahen yahan tak ke aap ko maut aa jaaye.
